title: About Namma Pondy Properties | Pondicherry Property Team
description: Who we are, how we verify documents, and why owners in Puducherry, Kottakuppam and overseas trust us with their property. Visit our Kuyavarpalayam office.
h1: Who We Are and How We Work
lead: We are a Pondicherry property team: buying, selling, developing layouts and managing property for owners who live here and owners who live abroad.
wa: Hi, I would like to know more about your services

bullets: Documents before enthusiasm. We check before we promote, not after.
Original documents stay in our office custody; clients carry verified copies against a signed undertaking.
Our brokerage is due after registration — we are paid when the work is finished.
We say no to properties we cannot stand behind, including when it costs us a deal.

paras: Namma Pondy Properties is part of Afra Ventures Pvt Ltd, which also runs an academy, a digital agency and other local businesses from Pondicherry. For property listings, see [The Plot One](https://theplotone.com/), our separate listings platform.

blocks.p: Buying, selling, or looking after a property from abroad — one message is enough.
